Build the AST node that a new op should be layered on top of

Source: R/execute.R
input_node.Rd

  • lazy + pending ops: returns .data$lazy_ops as-is.

  • lazy + no pending ops: returns a fresh ast_source(.data$schema), leaving the source pointer unset; compute()/ collect() supply .data$ptr as the lowering fallback source_ptr. A table that is the result of a CPU step (.data$origin, #10) hands its history to the source, for explain().

  • eager: returns a fresh ast_source(.data$schema, source_ptr = .data$ptr) so push_op() can call lower_and_execute() immediately without a separate source table.

Usage

input_node(.data)

Arguments

.data

A tbl_gpu object

Value

An ast_node to use as the input of a new node
